fuel_consumption.source_quote: Our 2013 forecasted mainline and express fuel consumption is presently approximately 1.46 billion gallons, and based on this forecast, a one cent per gallon increase in aviation fuel price results in a $15 million increase in annual expense.

instrument_type_details.notes: No fuel hedging. We have not entered into any transactions to hedge our fuel consumption. As a result, we fully realize the effects of any increase or decrease in fuel prices.

warnings: Stopped entering new fuel hedge transactions in Q3 2008. No fuel hedging as of December 31, 2012.

throughput.source_quote: Fuel consumption (gallons in millions): 1,447 (2012 Total Mainline and Express)
